dedupe_keys.name: spatial distribution road transport emissions for cams reg v8 1

description: TNO and collaborating CAMS-REG institutions publish the spatial allocation of road-transport emissions for version 8.1. A GeoPackage records road class, length, country, traffic volume, urban or rural or highway category, emissions and vehicle kilometres by vehicle type. NetCDF grids at 0.05 by 0.1 degrees provide annual nitrogen-oxide emissions and national percentage shares, with city boundaries for comparison. Zenodo resolves the inspected concept to record 19337413 and supplies a public ZIP under CC-BY-4.0, free with attribution. The short description does not identify the emission reference year. That gap and the allocation assumptions limit immediate comparison with local inventories. The vectors allow users to derive alternative grid sizes and can connect transport scenarios to air-pollution simulations. They complement aggregate emissions inventories with road-specific allocation information. Files and modelled emission totals were not independently checked.
name: Spatial distribution road transport emissions for CAMS-REG v8.1
